svg.title: Purser: the whole system
svg.desc: Six zones, left to right. 1 Who: the CFO with a passkey, a visitor or judge, an outside AI over MCP (read and propose only). 2 Surfaces: Home, /try, /try/negotiate, /verify, /proof, /airwallex and /airwallex/calls, /alta and /visa, the Purser Cloud console (Agents with their cards, Invoices, Books), /mcp. 3 Agents, Claude: Reader on Sonnet, Checker on Haiku, Sourcing on Haiku, Support on Sonnet, Treasury on Opus; agents propose, code decides. 4 Rails in code: the CFO policy, the terms SHA-256, passkey approvals (WebAuthn), refused when one cent changes, four eyes, the hash-chained audit log, the worst-case test. 5 Money rails, test money only: Airwallex sandbox, Alta testnet, Visa Intelligent Commerce via Airwallex Airi. 6 Proof and books: proof files, /verify, verify-all, the on-chain anchor, the T:0 ledger, CI. Dots travel the path of one payment: visitor, /try, Reader, Checker, CFO policy, passkey approval, Airwallex, proof files; a red dot takes a changed cent from the terms hash to Refused.
svg.text: Agents propose, code decides, the CFO signs the exact terms. Test money only: sandboxes and testnets.
